pages.text: SYN Daily Ledger, 2025-05-24. Share trades settle two business days after the trade (T+2). Market participants said the move reflected steady demand from retail and institutional investors. Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned. Share prices move with company results, market sentiment and the wider economy.

Investors open a depository account to hold their shares in electronic form. The figures above were correct at the time of publication and may change in future. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
